Name: (CP) Maru with Long Beta Hair Customizable Version
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
A fancier version of my previous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1916]Maru with Long Beta Hair[/url]﻿ mod.

It comes in three base hair colors-- [b]Magenta, Light Brown, [/b]and [b]Dark Brown[/b].
After DLing your preferred hair color, use the config to choose your preferred outfits-- in main clothes, winter clothes, beach swimsuit, and winter clothing.

Your choices are:
[b]Main Clothes: [/b]Purple, Pink, Green
[b]Hospital: [/b]Gray, Green
[b]Beach: [/b]Purple, Pink, Green
[b]Winter:[/b] Brown, Purple, Green

If there are any other colors you'd like to see, let me know!

(Note: If anyone knows an efficient way to make one single file where you can toggle both hair and clothing colors in one mod file, I'd be happy to update! My attempts at hair patch overlays failed, so making three different hair versions was my next best solution.)

--

[b]To install--
[/b]1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
2. Choose ONE hair color version from Main Files-- Magenta, Light Brown, or Dark Brown, and DL it.
3. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
4. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using Notepad++ or program of your choice) to choose your desired combination
Default is
Main Clothes: Purple
Hospital: Gray
Beach: Purple
Winter: Brown
Alternatively, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make your choice in-game.
5. Load up your game and enjoy!
